subject: Connector Catalyst: co-hosted demo track + co-marketing plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@streamline.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Connector Catalyst — co-hosted demo track at DevCon SE + webinar/blog idea

Hi Rohan,

Thanks again for the quick chat last week — Streamline enjoyed learning about Redwood's runtime optimizations. We had an idea we think is a good fit for both teams: run a half-day "Connector Catalyst" demo track at DevCon SE (Nov 17) that pairs a short keynote + integrated live demos between Streamline and Redwood, followed by a co-marketed webinar and a blog swap.

Quick bullets on what we had in mind:
- DevCon half-day track: 20–25 minute keynote (joint), two 15-minute integrated demos (product + partner), 30 minute hands-on clinic for 10–12 customers.
- Post-event: 60-minute co-hosted webinar (December), then reciprocal blog posts (partner-byline + customer story).
- Sponsorship: Streamline can cover the on-site booth and local logistics; looking to Redwood for speaker slot and promo support.

Attached is a very rough sponsor package and our logo kit. Can you loop in the right folks at Redwood (marketing, alliances, field) so we can align on scope, lead-handling, and a draft agenda? We can be flexible on dates for the webinar.

Attachments: Sponsor-Package-Streamline.pdf (application/pdf), Streamline-Logo-Kit.zip (application/zip)

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships
StreamlineAI
elena@streamline.ai
+1 415-555-0127

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@streamline.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Connector Catalyst — co-hosted demo track at DevCon SE + webinar/blog idea

Elena — really appreciate the proposal and the flexibility. Looping in Monica (field & events) and Neha (partnerships) to start logistics and lead routing, and Ben from sales for any pre-sales/demo access needs.

High-level asks from our side to get a production-ready plan: 
1) Draft agenda (we'll need timings and speaker names)
2) Sponsor commitment (who pays for speaker passes / booth / travel) and any discount we should apply to customers we invite
3) Lead flow: how do you want to share leads after the clinic (HubSpot vs CSV vs real-time API)?
4) Branding: speaker slides co-branding rules and logo assets (thanks for the kit).

Monica / Neha — can you pick two preferred webinar dates in early December and propose an agenda template here? We should also confirm whether DevCon is fine with a 90-minute slot or we need to compress.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Alliances Manager
Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Rohan — great to be in motion. For the sponsor commitment: Streamline will cover the booth and local logistics; we're asking Redwood for speaker passes for two (lead speaker + field engineer) and help amplifying the webinar to Redwood's developer list.

Lead flow: we can do HubSpot sync (preferred) or daily CSV. Our preference is HubSpot + UTM tagging so we can attribute signups. DocuSign link for the partnership addendum is here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc-connector-catalyst

Proposed dates for the webinar: Dec 7 or Dec 14 (both Tuesdays) at 11:00 PT. Attached is a short sponsor package that outlines tiers — we think joint keynote + hands-on clinic fits the "Spotlight" tier. Also attaching a sample 75-minute agenda (works as a starting point).

Attachments: Sponsor-Package-Streamline.pdf (application/pdf), Connector-Catalyst-Agenda-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

—Elena

Hi all — thanks Elena, and nice to meet you Rohan. Quick responses and next steps from events/field marketing:

- Webinar date: Dec 7 works best for Redwood (internal calendar). Dec 14 is a backup.
- Speaker passes: we can cover two speaker passes; Redwood can offer one discount code for customer invites (10% off conference registration).
- Lead flow: HubSpot sync preferred — Neha, can you own the HubSpot mapping and add Streamline as a partner source? We'll need the HubSpot company ID/portal (please send).
- Next: Elena, can you confirm final speaker names and send a short bio + headshot? Also please sign the addendum (DocuSign link in Elena's note).
